description: An otherwise well-formed complaint about a product the insurer doesn't offer (life insurance; default config products are motor/home/travel), with a bereavement mention. Covers FR-3.3 (deterministic 'product not offered' override to not_legitimate) and, since bereavement is an escalation trigger independent of label, the not_legitimate+escalated routing branch (review_queue, not the not-legitimate log).
turns: This is about my life insurance policy. My claim was denied last month after a family member passed away, and I want an explanation and for it to be reconsidered.
